Cedar Park Kitchen Catering

Buffet and drop-off catering for offices and family events, serving Austin and Cedar Park.

Buffet service for groups of up to 120 guests.

Menu

  • Lemon herb chicken
  • Black bean enchiladas (vegetarian)
  • Roasted seasonal vegetables (vegan, gluten-free)

Terms

Buffet pricing starts at $28 per person. Minimum order of $900 for buffet service.

A 25% deposit holds the date; the balance is due one week before the event.

Cancellation within 7 days of the event forfeits the deposit.
